comment: Two approvals on one session plus one on another. approval.request has NO request_id, no id, no tool name and no args — resolution is FIFO on a per-session queue keyed by session['session_key'] (reference-clients.md 5.1, 5.2). The second frame omits `choices` entirely so the client must synthesize them: allow_permanent present and truthy => [once, session, always, deny]; smart_denied => [once, deny].

payload.description: pipe a remote script to a shell
